title: SyncRequest
description: Body for POST /v1/sync. Uploads one or more completed offline attempts (each with events) from the SQLite outbox. Retry-safe: the same payload may be submitted repeatedly. Server deduplicates using client_attempt_id and client_event_id. No per-event HTTP in MVP. No secrets.

schema_version.description: JSON contract version. Distinct from each attempt's content_version.

client_request_id.description: Correlation id for this HTTP attempt. A retry may reuse this id or generate a new one; attempt/event ids are the durability keys.

worker_id.description: Must match worker_id on each enclosed attempt.

client_device_id.description: Optional opaque device id for diagnostics. Not an authentication secret.

attempts.description: Each item is one outbox row: a completed attempt including its events.
